messages.subject: Re: RSWAT crashes when changing behavioral threshold
messages.subject_clean: RSWAT crashes when changing behavioral threshold
messages.body_plain:
Hi Collins

I checked the data that you shared with me. The problem is that there are missing values in your simulated results (e.g., with simulation Nr. 22), that why the program does not work. I rerun your simulations with the same parameter set that you use with the newest R-SWAT (commited on Jan 1, 2023 - link below), it worked well.

https://github.com/tamnva/R-SWAT/tree/b90e91f0eed5748b339aa18e9c732f1d8daf7580

I guess your issue could be because the swat executable file that you are using (might be it does not work with simulation Nr. 22)

Cheers,
Tam
